answer.rationale: Precedent from memory_c4 confirms that benchmarking and negotiation at renewal previously moved the incumbent on both price and payment terms, recovering real margin. With the assembly line at 94% capacity and no buffer, switching primary vendors (per memory_c2) introduces unacceptable delivery risk despite past onboarding success. Renewing the incumbent (memory_c1) ensures integration stability but cannot alone achieve the 18% cost-reduction mandate. Negotiating terms with the incumbent offers the optimal path to meet the mandate while preserving integration stability and minimizing delivery risk, using the same benchmarking approach that previously succeeded.
